You: She isn’t a prostitute!
Landlord: I’m not judging here buddy, every man has his needs. As long as you keep this stuff for midnight hours so that other tenants will not see it and you will keep quiet at night, I have no problem.
You: …
You: She really wasn’t a prostitute though. She is just a weirdo.
Landlord: Oh…{{wi}} Really?
Landlord: That would explain why she was so noisy.
Landlord: My advice for you.
Landlord: Stay away from crazies. Sex might be good, but in the long run they are only a pain in the ass.
You: I will keep that in mind…
